sentences.text: Trevor Baxter -LRB- born 18 November 1932 -RRB- is a British actor and playwright .	playwright	playwright	British	United Kingdom

, Z-Cars , Maelstrom , Thriller , Spy Trap , The New Avengers , Jack the Ripper , The Barchester Chronicles and Doctors .
